newsitem.title: USA: Daschle says U.S. budget deal not likely this week.
newsitem.headline: Daschle says U.S. budget deal not likely this week.

text.p: Senate Democratic Leader Tom Daschle of South Dakota said Wednesday he did not expect a budget agreement with majority Republicans this week.
"It's unlikely in the next couple of days," Daschle told reporters when asked if an agreement could be reached with the White House and Republicans this week.

Daschle and Budget Committee Democrats will meet President Clinton Thursday. He said Democrats would use the meeting to emphasize their priorities, including children's health, medicare and crime control.
